verdict.headline: GDP softens, AWS surges 37%, SPX reclaims the bear threshold on Day 1
verdict.label: Regime threshold reclaimed: GDP +1.5%, Core PCE +0.1% MoM, AMZN AWS 37% drove SPX to 7,416; AAPL services miss and 30Y at 5.12% are Friday's tests
verdict.rationale_short: GDP Q2 advance +1.5% (below 2.1% consensus) and Core PCE +0.1% MoM (below 0.2% expected) together drove September hike probability sharply lower; Amazon's AWS grew 37% year-over-year — fastest in 18 quarters and far beyond the 31.6% estimate — completing the cloud AI ROI validation alongside MSFT's 43%. The S&P 500 closed at 7,416, reclaiming the 7,380 threshold one session after Wednesday's formal conversion. AAPL's services revenue ($30.74B vs $31.22B estimate), Greater China ($18.82B vs $19.67B), and Q4 guidance (+9-11% vs >12% consensus) all missed; shares fell 4-7.8% after hours. Friday's Q2 Employment Cost Index at 8:30 AM ET is the rate path's next binary — a hot print resets today's gains.

watchlist_mentions.note: $455.92 (+16.7%): best single-day gain in years; Azure $100B annual revenue gap-open held and extended all session. AI ARR $37B (+123% YoY) is demand from external enterprise customers, not internal consumption. New level re-rates the AI cloud premium.

Regular close $237.53 (+4.8%); AH $256.97 (+9.12%). AWS $42.2B (+37%, fastest in 18 quarters). AI + custom chip businesses each >$25B annual run rate at triple-digit growth. AWS margins up 650bps YoY. The AH level is Friday's opening reference.

Regular close $333.78 (-1.3%); AH -4-7.8% to ~$319. Services $30.74B missed $31.22B; Greater China $18.82B missed $19.67B; Q4 guidance +9-11% missed >12% consensus. iPhone and total revenue beat. Three simultaneous misses hit the quality-rotation thesis at the same time.

$532.81 (-9% regular session). Q2 FCF -93%, op margin 31% vs 43% prior year thesis unchanged. Wednesday AH close ($529) and today's close ($532) imply the Q2 print is priced; the multi-quarter FCF trough from the capex schedule is not.

$193.97 (+2.1%). AWS 37% and Azure 43% are the strongest dual confirmation of AI compute demand organically funded that the series has seen — necessary but not sufficient for the circular-financing overhang to clear. No add before Aug 26 Q2 FY27 call. $216 stop intact.
$385.53. META $31B Q2 capex + AMZN AI chips >$25B annual run rate are two simultaneous custom silicon demand signals. Broadcom's ASIC design-win thesis strengthened by both prints.
~$126.95 (-0.43%). US retaliatory strikes on IRGC sites reinforce DoD AI spending urgency — decision-intelligence and drone-defense are PLTR AIP use cases. Aug 3 Q2 AH; options pricing ~15% swing.

~$374.66 (-4.5%). Underperformed despite AWS/Azure beats. Azure 43% and AWS 37% are positive for TSMC N3/N2 utilization; the decline may reflect Taiwan geopolitical repricing or profit-taking after prior run-up.

~$65,000 estimated close. Soft GDP + cool PCE + AMZN beat constructive; VIX pullback to 17.5 reduced risk-off correlation pressure. Gate 2 ($62,000) intact with ~$3,000 buffer. Weekend Iran risk is the primary tail.

dont_buy.reason: Services ($30.74B miss), China ($18.82B miss), and Q4 guidance shortfall (+9-11% vs >12%) all miss simultaneously — the same three metrics the morning brief identified as the quality-rotation decision gates. AH at $319 prices the quarter's miss; it does not yet price a sustained services deceleration if Q4 guidance is structurally below the prior growth rate.
dont_buy.better_entry: Post-Q4 FY26 earnings (October 2026): only if services growth reaccelerates above 15% YoY AND Q1 FY27 guidance exceeds $112B. Or $305-310 on a regime selloff that reprices quality names indiscriminately.

trade_setups.thesis: Q2 Employment Cost Index at 8:30 AM ET July 31 is the remaining rate-path uncertainty after today's soft GDP and PCE. A print above 1.1% QoQ re-opens September hike probability above 70% regardless of the PCE softness. Both TLT and TBT enter overnight with uncertainty: AMZN AH is bullish for risk assets but does not mechanically affect bond positioning. The ECI print, not the earnings queue, determines Friday's bond direction and whether the SPX 7,380 reclaim survives a second close.
trade_setups.entry: Build equal-weight TLT long / TBT long before 8:30 AM ET July 31. Close the losing leg within 30 minutes. Flatten both if ECI prints 0.9-1.0% QoQ (consensus range).
trade_setups.invalidation: ECI 0.9-1.0% QoQ — September probability holds at ~45%, no directional edge, both legs flat.
trade_setups.horizon: Entry before 8:30 AM ET July 31; resolve by 9:00 AM ET

trade_setups.thesis: AWS 37% is the fastest growth in 18 quarters. The AI and custom chip businesses each exceeded $25B annual run rates at triple-digit growth, making AWS AI a material revenue line for the first time. At $256.97 AH, the thesis is AWS demand compounding alongside MSFT's Azure into the NVDA Aug 26 call. The level at which the AWS AI story justifies the AH price without the Anthropic one-time gain ($53.4B in Q2 GAAP net income) is closer to $245-250 — Friday open sellers provide the dip.
trade_setups.entry: Scale on Friday's open dip from $257 AH; $250 is near-term support; $260 is the first resistance. Target $270 by end of August on NVDA Aug 26 confirmation.
trade_setups.invalidation: ECI above 1.1% QoQ re-prices September hike probability above 70% and collapses the multiple expansion premise. Or Friday close below $245.
trade_setups.horizon: Near-term: post-ECI Friday open; medium-term: through NVDA Aug 26

trade_setups.thesis: The quality-rotation thesis that supported AAPL's premium multiple was built on services margin expansion. Q3 FY26 hit three misses simultaneously: services ($30.74B), China ($18.82B), Q4 guidance (+9-11%). The AH move to $319 is the first pricing leg. The question is whether Friday's regular open converges toward the AH level or buyers emerge at $320-325 on iPhone strength and reject the services story as a one-quarter miss.
trade_setups.entry: No position until Friday's open; watch $320 as the structural dividing line. A break below $315 on Friday's open on high volume is the structural thesis damage signal.
trade_setups.invalidation: If AAPL opens and stabilizes above $322-325, the market is treating the triple miss as noise rather than thesis damage. Revisit at Q4 FY26 earnings (October 2026).
trade_setups.horizon: Near-term: 2-5 sessions; reassess at Q4 FY26 earnings

bear_case: Q2 Employment Cost Index at 8:30 AM ET July 31 prints above 1.1% QoQ — the Fed's most direct wage-inflation signal — restoring September hike probability above 70% despite today's soft GDP and PCE. In that scenario, 30Y extending above 5.25% converts the single-session equity relief into a rate-driven reversal, with AAPL's -4-7.8% AH print adding a Nasdaq headwind. US retaliatory strikes on Iran IRGC sites risk a countermove over the weekend that pushes Brent back toward $93. If SPX closes below 7,380 on Friday, today's reclaim was a one-session technical bounce rather than a regime reversal. The read no longer holds if SPX loses 7,380 on Friday's close.
